feature: Truthful correction provenance in transcript exports

scenarios.name: Manual edits are not attributed to AI
scenarios.given: a finalized transcript line has recognized wording and may already have an AI correction
scenarios.when: the user edits it, edits it again and exports Markdown
scenarios.then: the correction is explicitly manual, the first recognized wording and latest edited wording remain available, and exporting changes no transcript identity or provenance

scenarios.name: Known AI corrections retain their attribution
scenarios.given: a transcript correction has a named AI model and original wording
scenarios.when: the conversation is exported as Markdown
scenarios.then: the original and corrected wording remain present with AI attribution and the stored model provenance is unchanged

scenarios.name: Legacy corrections do not invent an author
scenarios.given: legacy corrected lines have absent or blank correction provenance, or a line has no original wording
scenarios.then: legacy original and corrected wording remain under a neutral correction label without inventing AI or manual attribution, and an uncorrected line has no correction entry
